name: ArenaTableColumn
description: One column's configuration. A column says how its cells are headed and set, never what markup goes in them -- the consumer writes an ArenaTableCell per cell.

header.description: The column's label, drawn in the header row.

width.description: A CSS width for the column. Omit to let the table distribute.

numeric.description: The column holds figures: the mono face, tabular numerals and the gold ink, and figure-aligned in the card layout.

sortable.description: Whether this column's header is an activation target. A declared boolean rather than "is sortChange bound?", because Arena never derives what it draws from what a consumer listens for, the same reason ArenaTableRow.interactive is one. It costs no tab stop: the header row is already row 0 of the grid's roving cursor, so a sortable header is activated with Enter or Space on the cell the user is already on. Without ArenaTable.sort no header is a target however many columns declare it, because a control that draws a direction it does not know is worse than no control.

mobileLayout.description: How this column renders in card mode: a label/value pair, or a full-width strip with no label whose contents sit at its end, which suits an actions cell rather than a long value.
